AppText + theme tokens (colors/shadows) added.

(L14), side?: 'left'|'right' (L15) kept verbatim with the same defaulting to 'right'. className?: string (L16) — a web-only styling string — is re-expressed as the native-idiomatic `style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>` applied to the panel at the exact cn() merge position (web L68), and documented as the className analogue. Focus-trap useEffect L23-47 is DOM-specific and mostly dropped, with each branch documented: the !open early-return (L24) and drawer null guard (L25-26) are subsumed by the `mounted` gate; document.activeElement capture (L27) + querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR) auto-focus-first (L29-30) + the Tab forward/back focus cycling (L32-40, L34-39) + addEventListener('keydown') (L42) + the cleanup focus-restore (L43-46) all rely on document.activeElement / HTMLElement.focus() / DOM key events with no portable RN equivalent, so they are dropped (the native Modal already contains screen-reader focus). ONLY the Escape branch (L33 `if (e.key === 'Escape') { onClose() }`) survives, mapped to the Modal's onRequestClose=onClose (which also covers Android hardware-back). The dependency array [open, onClose] (L47) is preserved in spirit by the native animation effect keyed on [open, mounted, progress].

if(!open) return null (L49) -> `if (!mounted) return null`: native keeps the overlay mounted across the exit slide (deferred unmount), setting mounted=false only after the exit animation finishes, so the panel animates out instead of popping. open still gates visibility (open->true sets mounted true and springs in; open->false times out then unmounts).

createPortal outer wrapper L50-51 (div role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label={title||'Panel'} fixed inset-0 z-50) -> the transparent Modal + a flex:1 root View; role='dialog'/aria-modal map to the panel's accessibilityViewIsModal and aria-label={title||'Panel'} maps to the panel accessibilityLabel with the identical 'Panel' fallback. z-50/fixed inset-0 are handled by the Modal overlay.

Backdrop motion.div L52-59: initial/animate/exit opacity 0<->1 (L53-55) -> an Animated.View whose opacity is the `progress` value (0->1 on enter, 1->0 on exit); className bg-[--surface-overlay] backdrop-blur-sm (L56) -> styles.backdrop (absolute fill + translucent rgba(0,0,0,0.62); the backdrop-blur has no RN analogue and degrades to a flat translucent overlay); onClick={onClose} (L57) -> a full-fill Pressable onPress={onClose}; aria-hidden='true' (L58) -> the Pressable's accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' (decorative, matching the ConfirmDialog backdrop), the close action remaining reachable via the visible Close button and onRequestClose.

Panel motion.div L60-70: initial/exit x '100%'/'-100%' and animate x:0 (L61-63) -> an Animated.View with transform translateX = progress.interpolate([0,1] -> [hiddenOffset, 0]); hiddenOffset is +panelWidth for side='right' and -panelWidth for side='left' (the percentage-translate analogue), measured via onLayout and defaulting to the screen width so the panel starts fully off-screen. transition spring damping:30 stiffness:300 (L64) -> Animated.spring with the same damping:30 / stiffness:300 (mass:1). className L65-69 (absolute top-0 bottom-0 flex w-full max-w-md flex-col glass-panel rounded-none border-0, plus the side-conditional right-0/left-0 + border-l/border-r white/[0.06], plus the merged className) -> styles.panel (position absolute, top:0, bottom:0, width:'100%', maxWidth:448, colors.surface, shadows.panel) + styles.panelRight/panelLeft (the side anchor + the 1px side border in colors.border) + the passed-in `style` appended last (the className merge position, web L68). glass-panel/rounded-none/border-0 map to the flat token-backed surface with explicit side border only.
